# 词典 B

## 概述

本页收录以字母 B 开头的实用词汇，按职场与商务、日常与社交、技术相关等场景分组。每个词条给出词性、含义、常见搭配与例句，并附易混淆词辨析和高频短语，便于按场景查阅与记忆。

## 职场与商务

| 词汇        | 词性  | 含义              | 常见搭配                              | 例句                                                          |
| ----------- | ----- | ----------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| benchmark   | n./v. | 基准/进行基准测试 | industry benchmark, benchmark against | We benchmark our performance against industry leaders.        |
| briefing    | n.    | 简报              | daily briefing, project briefing      | The morning briefing covered yesterday's outage.              |
| budget      | n./v. | 预算/做预算       | annual budget, budget for             | We need to budget for additional cloud costs.                 |
| bottleneck  | n.    | 瓶颈              | performance bottleneck                | The database query is the main bottleneck.                    |
| brainstorm  | v./n. | 头脑风暴          | brainstorm ideas/solutions            | Let's brainstorm some creative solutions for this feature.    |
| brand       | n.    | 品牌              | brand awareness, personal brand       | Building brand awareness is our top priority this quarter.    |
| breakdown   | n.    | 分解、明细        | cost breakdown, task breakdown        | Please provide a breakdown of the project timeline.           |
| bilateral   | adj.  | 双边的            | bilateral agreement                   | The two companies signed a bilateral partnership deal.        |
| boost       | v./n. | 提升              | boost performance/morale              | The team-building event boosted team morale significantly.    |
| bureaucracy | n.    | 官僚主义          | reduce bureaucracy                    | Too much bureaucracy slows down decision-making.              |
| buyout      | n.    | 收购              | management buyout                     | The management buyout was finalized last quarter.             |
| baseline    | n.    | 基线              | establish a baseline                  | We need to establish a baseline before measuring improvement. |

## 日常与社交

| 词汇       | 词性    | 含义            | 常见搭配                     | 例句                                                             |
| ---------- | ------- | --------------- | ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| balance    | n./v.   | 平衡/保持平衡   | work-life balance            | Maintaining work-life balance is essential for health.           |
| bargain    | n./v.   | 便宜货/讨价还价 | get a bargain                | I got a real bargain at the electronics sale.                    |
| beverage   | n.      | 饮料            | hot/cold beverage            | Would you like a beverage before the meeting starts?             |
| boundary   | n.      | 边界、界限      | set boundaries               | It's important to set boundaries between work and personal life. |
| browse     | v.      | 浏览            | browse the internet/store    | I was just browsing online and found this great deal.            |
| burden     | n./v.   | 负担            | financial burden             | Student loans can be a heavy financial burden.                   |
| blend      | v./n.   | 混合            | blend in, blend of           | The café offers a unique blend of coffee beans.                  |
| belongings | n.      | 随身物品        | personal belongings          | Please keep your personal belongings with you at all times.      |
| brilliant  | adj.    | 杰出的、明亮的  | brilliant idea               | That was a brilliant solution to the performance problem.        |
| brief      | adj./v. | 简短的/简要说明 | brief summary, brief someone | Let me give you a brief summary of the discussion.               |
| brunch     | n.      | 早午餐          | go for brunch                | Let's go for brunch this Sunday at the new place.                |

## 技术相关

| 词汇        | 词性    | 含义          | 常见搭配                             | 例句                                                   |
| ----------- | ------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| backend     | n./adj. | 后端          | backend service/developer            | The backend team is optimizing the database queries.   |
| boolean     | n./adj. | 布尔值/布尔型 | boolean expression/value             | This function returns a boolean indicating success.    |
| branch      | n./v.   | 分支/创建分支 | feature branch, branch off           | Create a new branch before making any changes.         |
| bug         | n.      | 缺陷、错误    | fix a bug, report a bug              | QA reported a critical bug in the payment module.      |
| build       | n./v.   | 构建          | build pipeline, build fails          | The nightly build failed due to a missing dependency.  |
| buffer      | n.      | 缓冲区        | buffer overflow, data buffer         | The application uses a ring buffer for log events.     |
| batch       | n./adj. | 批处理        | batch processing, batch job          | We run a batch job every night to sync user data.      |
| bandwidth   | n.      | 带宽、精力    | network bandwidth, limited bandwidth | I don't have the bandwidth to take on another project. |
| binary      | n./adj. | 二进制        | binary file, binary search           | The compiled binary is about 12 MB in size.            |
| breakpoint  | n.      | 断点          | set a breakpoint                     | Set a breakpoint on line 42 to inspect the variable.   |
| boilerplate | n.      | 模板代码      | boilerplate code                     | The CLI generates boilerplate code for new components. |

## 易混淆词辨析

| 词组               | 区别说明                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| borrow vs. lend    | borrow「借入」，lend「借出」。Can I **borrow** your pen? / Can you **lend** me your pen?                                     |
| beside vs. besides | beside「在旁边」，besides「除此之外」。Sit **beside** me. / **Besides** English, she speaks French.                          |
| bring vs. take     | bring「带来（朝向说话者）」，take「带走（远离说话者）」。**Bring** it here. / **Take** it there.                             |
| brake vs. break    | brake「刹车」，break「打破」。Hit the **brake**. / Don't **break** the glass.                                                |
| below vs. under    | below「在下方（不接触）」，under「在正下方（可接触）」。The temperature is **below** zero. / The cat is **under** the table. |

## 高频短语

| 短语            | 含义           | 例句                                                              |
| --------------- | -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| bring up        | 提起、提出     | She brought up an important issue during the review.              |
| break down      | 分解、故障     | Let's break down the task into smaller subtasks.                  |
| by all means    | 当然可以       | By all means, feel free to share your thoughts.                   |
| back and forth  | 来回反复       | We went back and forth on the design before finalizing it.        |
| be in charge of | 负责           | She is in charge of the frontend team.                            |
| boil down to    | 归结为         | The problem boils down to a misconfigured database connection.    |
| bear in mind    | 记住           | Bear in mind that the API rate limit is 100 requests per minute.  |
| be on track     | 按计划进行     | The project is on track for a mid-April release.                  |
| bump into       | 偶遇           | I bumped into an old colleague at the conference.                 |
| build on        | 在……基础上发展 | Let's build on the progress we made last sprint.                  |
| bail out        | 救助、退出     | The government bailed out the struggling bank.                    |
| bounce back     | 恢复、反弹     | The stock price bounced back after the quarterly earnings report. |

## 补充词汇

| ---------- | ------- | ----------- | --------------------- |
| backtick   | n.      | 反引号      | wrap in backticks     |
| blocker    | n.      | 阻碍因素    | critical blocker      |
| blueprint  | n.      | 蓝图        | project blueprint     |
| breadcrumb | n.      | 面包屑导航  | breadcrumb navigation |
| bulk       | n./adj. | 大量/批量的 | bulk operation/import |
| bypass     | v.      | 绕过        | bypass validation     |
